"Ripples of wonder, waves of might;
Ebb and flow, a constant fight;
Tides of change, a story told;
Of the ocean's power, young and old.

The waves, a chorus, sang of the deep;
A symphony of secrets, whispers, and sleep;
The sand, a stage, for the waves' grand play;
A dance of light, in the ocean's gray.

In the waves' wild heart, a poem beats;
A rhythm of the sea, a symphony of treats;
A language of the deep, a tongue of the tide;
A poem, born of the ocean's wild, wild ride.

The waves, a mirror, reflect the soul;
A reflection of the heart, a story to be told;
The ocean's poem, a tale of the sea;
A symphony of wonder, for you and me."
